verdict.rationale: Bruno stores collections as plain-text files and ships a built-in Git UI (init, diff, pull, commit) enabling versioning and review of API 'automations' (collections/scripts) directly from the app, per docs. However, explicit rollback/revert functionality is not documented, and this is git-based version control for API collections, not a dedicated automation history/rollback feature. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert documentation, hands-on evidence of reviewing/approving changes via PRs, and any independent confirmation the Git diff/rollback workflow works reliably (community threads focus on other bugs, not git-versioning issues).
